## Finding

Describe the concrete implementation or engineering concern. Separate confirmed code
evidence from broader ideas.

## Evidence

List the relevant files, symbols, behavior, measurements, or reproductions.

## Why it matters

Explain the likely correctness, maintainability, reliability, security, performance,
developer-experience, or product cost.

## Recommended direction

Describe a sensible direction, including important non-goals and approaches that should
not be taken.

## Existing roadmap / issue overlap

State what was checked and why this is not already covered, or link the related item and
explain the distinction.
